name: personal-os
description: Personal collection of Claude Code plugins for everyday automation, research, and quality-of-life tooling.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Literature review for purchases and questions: searches Reddit (with engagement data), HN, StackExchange, and the web; verifies brand legitimacy; scores source trust; produces a cited summary. Health questions route through a medical-evidence rigor layer that enumerates options and grades claims by evidence, risk/cost, and community frequency.

plugins.name: workout
plugins.description: Progressive home-strength programs from a curated template + generator engine, equipment-aware and injury-aware; equipment gap advisor with research-plugin handoff; local SQLite storage; printable markdown/CSV/artifact outputs.
